stories.title: 公司继续与工会斗争，向 700 名符合资格的美光员工发放相当于 5 年工资的奖金 / 5 years’ worth of salary in bonuses given to 700 eligible Micron workers as company continues to battle union

sources.title: 公司继续与工会斗争，向 700 名符合资格的美光员工发放相当于 5 年工资的奖金 / 5 years’ worth of salary in bonuses given to 700 eligible Micron workers as company continues to battle union
sources.title_zh: 公司继续与工会斗争，向 700 名符合资格的美光员工发放相当于 5 年工资的奖金
sources.title_en: 5 years’ worth of salary in bonuses given to 700 eligible Micron workers as company continues to battle union
sources.title_original: 5 years’ worth of salary in bonuses given to 700 eligible Micron workers as company continues to battle union
sources.summary: Eligible employees get an annual performance bonus, a mass-production bonus, and a one-time appreciation bonus. A quarterly profit bonus has also been introduced starting January 2027.
sources.summary_zh: 符合条件的员工可获得年度绩效奖金、量产奖金、一次性增值奖金。从 2027 年 1 月开始，还引入了季度利润奖金。
